candidate.source_summary: session_key comes from Django's SessionStore which inherits from SessionBase. The session key is generated by _get_new_session_key() method from the parent class.
candidate.sink_summary: The session key is assigned to a cookie that will be sent with HTTP requests. This cookie represents the user's authenticated session.
candidate.guard_summary: Session keys are generated using Django's built-in session key generation (cryptographically random). The session is saved to database before cookie assignment. Standard Django session security controls apply (expiration, secure flags from settings).
candidate.risk_pattern: Session key assignment to cookie in test client login method - follows standard Django session management pattern but in test context.
